evidence_note: The authoritative transaction signatures, errors, logs, before/after states and deltas are stored per case in evidence_file; case names below avoid stale duplicate signatures across reruns.

findings.outcome: Signed local admin stored max_configurable_creator_fee_bps=10001; 10000 control also succeeded. Config maximum changed 300 to the selected value. Administrator-gated only.

Zero and -1 day lengths persisted through the zero start/end and zero supply update branch; period changed from 1 in each committed global schedule. Later rollover and arbitrary-user writes were not tested.
Paused status=0 synthetic sharing state migrated the pool creator. Confirms the absent active-status guard, not ordinary permissionless reachability.
Unverified normal metadata creator succeeded and committed; empty creator vector failed ProgramFailedToComplete and rolled back. Robustness confirmed; theft and verified-only patch unsupported.
User-signed close with unclaimed=5 deleted the accumulator and refunded lamports. No external close or cashback-asset forfeiture claimed.
Current admin installed a nonsigning incoming admin. Operational lockout remains conditional on losing that key.
Exact-input 337 succeeded and debited all 337 quote units under the fixture fee table; protocol recipient gained 2 and buyback recipient 1.
Direct whitelisted buy paid no separate fee; routed buy paid 45926 units to buyback recipient for the same signer.
Successful buy_v2 created the user accumulator with volume=0 and zero incentive counters. No active live campaign claimed.
Mixed-direction route rejected custom 6086 and rolled back. No admitted transfer-fee intermediate route; Main route not directly tested.

Fresh signed original Pump migrate_v2 control succeeded using the genuine Pump PDA through CPI. Injecting creator_fee_bps=10001 into the preexisting curve also succeeded and committed pool.creator_fee_bps=10001, proving the field reaches AMM once such state exists. No valid upstream Pump creation/CTO sequence was shown to produce that invalid state, so the upstream-bypass exploit remains inconclusive.

Complete original AMM IDL inventory exposes GlobalVolumeAccumulator and init_user_volume_accumulator but no global-volume initializer/bootstrap entrypoint. admin_update_token_incentives with the account absent failed custom 3012. Confirms the source/deployed-interface fresh-deployment gap only; live account state was not queried and no live absence is claimed.
Foreign-mint claim saturated cashback_claimed from 13 to u64::MAX. Separate next one-unit claim failed AMM Overflow 6023 with unchanged state.
Signed admin scheduled rewards with a delegated reward vault. No live unsafe campaign or later delegate seizure tested.
Fixed PUMP mint carrying synthetic PermanentDelegate was accepted as pool base. Fixed-address admission branch only, not live exploit capability.

Fresh signed original Pump migrate_v2 admitted a canonical Token-2022 PermanentDelegate quote and created/funded the pool. Subsequent Token-2022 TransferChecked signed only by the independent delegate moved one unit from the canonical pool quote vault; pool owner did not sign. Canonical vault amount changed 67417750273 to 67417750272 and recipient 0 to 1. Ordinary noncanonical creation rejected the extension, and canonical Token-2022 control succeeded. Confirms synthetic canonical admission/custody, not a currently approved unsafe live mint.
Wrong signer rejected InvalidAdmin custom 6005. Fixed admin private key remains unavailable; no sigVerify=false or other bypass was used. Unchanged in the second pass.
